changelog: Added native jev_mcp backend (jev-1.13-free) with automatic agent registration and Global Context offloading rules for fast batch triage and multi-criteria scoring.
Added 1-shot assistant tools and NotificationListenerService integration to android_automation_mcp.
Merged upstream updates through 2.0.5-beta.5: Discord theme (default dark theme) and custom theme indicator in ThemeGallery.
Added file picker settings for AntiGem and Ubuntu chroot, plus storage management and installation error handling.
Security & SSH: added LocalServerAuth (keeps bridge token and phone tools key out of ps on servers), strict SSH host key checking via SshSessionFactory, and exact host matching for local dev SSL.

Terminal & IDE: improved keyboard focus handling in LocalTerminalDialog, Termux Recents icon, session management, IDE file tree refactor, delayed loading indicators, and FloatingSwitcherWidget press feedback.
Fixes: runtime language-change chat loader crash fix, TTS engine startup fallback, termux-x11 RUN_COMMAND update, and coreLibraryDesugaring 2.1.5.
Preserved AntiGem Fork architecture: persistent WindowManager overlay, 8-way resizing with proportional aspect ratio lock, Notes sync integrity, ai.antidev package ID, and in-app debug update checks.
